position_reference: RAMBO analytical FL endpoint; absolute target, not delta
origin: base world x/y projected onto world z=0; com_offset=(0,0,0), not measured whole-body CoM
axes: gravity-level controller axes; +x forward/+y left at level pose, +z up; retain matrix definition under roll/pitch
force_sign: desired robot-on-environment force; QP reaction and external injection use its negative
force_policy: preserve requested; transformed/filtered/executed force exactly zero
history: completed high-level hold intervals; not measured EEF trajectory
consumption: base/force read pre-step; FL IK updated post-step; residual runner consumes previous returned observation; record command IDs rather than retime labels
execution_dtype: float32; requested JSON numbers preserved; transformed records dtype conversion before zero force
